EmailTemplate.textOnly:
YOU don’t want to MISS this ONE!!
April 25 & 26th is our BIG 10 year Anniversary Event!
Come spend the weekend with
Memphis Invest
In our hometown, Memphis Tennessee!
We would love it if you would join us Friday night, April 25th, for our
Welcome Reception at the host hotel DoubleTree Hilton located in beautiful downtown Memphis.
Meet the Memphis Invest team for the first time or shake hands with us again!
Then on Saturday the 26th at 9am....
Learn about everything new we have planned for your financial future!
We will be announcing some brand new programs for all of our current and future clients!
Including:
- updated data and figures on Memphis - updated data and figures on Dallas - introduction to our newest market Houston - brand new financing options including large scale financing from B2R
PLUS we are building brand new homes for our investors to add to their portfolios!
Saturday night dinner will be held inside the
China Exhibit at The World Famous Memphis Zoo
We are going to be thanking some of our longest and most loyal clients, celebrating all of our client's success.
We are so grateful for the opportunity to work with all of our investors who rely on us from so far away to protect their real estate investment.
HURRY! TIME IS RUNNING OUT!
RESERVE YOUR SEAT TODAY! Seats are Limited!
Please feel free to bring a spouse, friend or relative!
Please call me directly at 901-312-1790 or respond to this email if you have further questions! You can also click this link to sign up online
http://info.memphisinvest.com/celebration-2014
